meta.root_cause: double_escape of en/id HTML-template values in i18n.js (uniform) for 168/172 instances; 4/172 are placeholder-text-only mismatches with correct escaping
meta.batch_strategy: A single scripted pass can un-escape all double-escaped en/id HTML-template values in i18n.js (decode \" -> "), restoring rendering for 84 keys (A+B groups, 168 instances); 152/168 then match zh baseline exactly. B-group (16) + C-group (4) additionally need placeholder text restored (translate zh placeholder into en/id). Inline Chinese in app.js is a separate P1 backlog.
